papers.title: ChipNeMo: Domain-Adapted LLMs for Chip Design
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首次系统证明领域适配预训练（芯片设计语料 + RLHF）可大幅提升 LLM 在 EDA 脚本生成、工程助手、Bug 分析三类任务上的表现，ChipNeMo-70B 超越 GPT-4；为后续 PCB/硬件设计 LLM 的领域适配技术路线奠定实证基础
papers.summary_en: ChipNeMo applies domain-adaptive tokenization, continued pretraining on internal chip design corpora, and instruction-tuning aligned with EDA expert knowledge to produce a family of models (13B–70B). Tested on three internal applications—engineering chatbot, Tcl/Python EDA script generation, and bug report analysis—the 70B variant outperforms GPT-4 on two of three tasks. The work demonstrates that domain adaptation, not raw model size, is the key lever for hardware-design LLMs, motivating the field-wide shift toward specialized pretraining data pipelines.
papers.summary_zh: ChipNeMo 对 LLaMA 系列模型进行领域自适应分词、芯片设计语料继续预训练和领域专属指令对齐，构建了 13B 和 70B 两款模型。在三项内部任务（GPU 工程助手聊天、EDA Tcl/Python 脚本生成、Bug 分析）中，ChipNeMo-70B 在工程助手和脚本生成两项上超越 GPT-4，Bug 分析接近。本文证明对于硬件设计场景，领域适配比单纯扩大模型规模更关键，成为后续 PCB/EDA 领域模型研究（ChipBench、VerilogEval 等）的重要参照起点。

papers.title: ChatEDA: A Large Language Model Powered Autonomous Agent for EDA
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个 LLM 驱动的完整 EDA 自主 Agent，通过微调的 AutoMage 模型实现从 RTL 到 GDSII 的自然语言任务分解→脚本生成→工具调用闭环，建立了 LLM-Agent-for-EDA 的技术范式；此后 PCB 设计自动化论文均以此为基础范式
papers.summary_en: ChatEDA introduces an autonomous EDA agent where a fine-tuned LLM (AutoMage) serves as the central controller, receiving natural-language design goals and decomposing them into subtasks dispatched to commercial EDA tools (OpenROAD, Yosys, etc.). The system closes the RTL-to-GDSII loop without manual script editing. AutoMage, derived from CodeLlama with EDA-specific instruction tuning, outperforms GPT-4 on design-script-generation benchmarks. First presented at MLCAD 2023; expanded journal version published in IEEE TCAD 2024.
papers.summary_zh: ChatEDA 以微调的 AutoMage（基于 CodeLlama 的 EDA 指令微调版本）为核心控制器，接收自然语言设计目标，自动分解为子任务并调用 OpenROAD、Yosys 等 EDA 工具，实现 RTL→GDSII 无需人工干预的闭环设计流程。AutoMage 在脚本生成任务上优于 GPT-4。本文在 MLCAD 2023 首次提出后扩展为 IEEE TCAD 2024 期刊版，是 LLM EDA Agent 领域的奠基性工作，直接启发了 PCB 级自动化 Agent 的设计范式。

papers.title: LaMAGIC: Language-Model-based Topology Generation for Analog Integrated Circuits
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个将模拟电路拓扑生成建模为语言模型序列生成任务的工作，单次前向推理从自然语言规格生成完整电路拓扑；为 NL→电路结构生成范式在 PCB 层面的延伸（PCBSchemaGen、SchGen 等）奠定方法基础
papers.summary_en: LaMAGIC frames analog IC topology generation as a sequence-to-sequence problem, fine-tuning a transformer-based LM to map functional specifications (in natural language) to circuit netlist-like token sequences in a single pass. Evaluated on opamp and voltage regulator topologies, it outperforms random search and GNN baselines in both validity and target-spec satisfaction. Presented at ICML 2024; extended by LaMAGIC2 (TODAES) in 2025 with richer circuit formulations.
papers.summary_zh: LaMAGIC 将模拟集成电路拓扑生成建模为序列到序列任务，通过监督微调 Transformer 语言模型，单次推理将自然语言功能规格映射为电路连接表 Token 序列。在运算放大器和稳压器拓扑生成上优于随机搜索和图神经网络基线，在规格满足率和电路有效率指标上均有显著提升。以 ICML 2024 发表，后续 LaMAGIC2（TODAES 2025）进一步丰富了电路表示形式。该范式直接启发了 PCBSchemaGen 和 SchGen 等 PCB 板级原理图生成工作。

papers.title: A Survey of Research in Large Language Models for Electronic Design Automation
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 涵盖 102 篇 LLM+EDA 研究（70 篇已发表 + 32 篇高质量预印本）的综合综述，系统梳理模型架构、定制技术（RAG/微调/提示工程）和应用领域，是理解 PCB 设计自动化在整个 EDA-LLM 生态中定位的最佳入口
papers.summary_en: This TODAES survey covers 102 papers (70 peer-reviewed + 32 quality preprints) on LLMs for EDA, spanning system-level design, RTL generation, logic synthesis, physical design (including PCB-layer work), and verification. It taxonomizes customization techniques into fine-tuning, RAG, and prompting families, and identifies open challenges in data scarcity, hallucination for safety-critical constraints, and multi-tool agent orchestration. Authored by researchers from Duke and Texas A&M universities.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述覆盖 LLM+EDA 领域 102 篇文献（70 篇已发表、32 篇高质量预印本），从系统级设计、RTL 生成、逻辑综合、物理设计（含板级 PCB 工作）到验证全流程进行系统梳理。将定制化技术分为微调、RAG 和提示工程三类，指出数据稀缺、安全约束幻觉和多工具 Agent 协同是核心开放挑战。由 Duke 大学和德克萨斯 A&M 联合撰写，发表于 ACM TODAES 2025，是进入该领域的必读综述。

papers.title: AnalogCoder: Analog Circuit Design via Training-Free Code Generation
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将模拟电路设计建模为 Python 代码生成问题，无需微调即可用 GPT-4 等通用 LLM 设计电路并通过仿真反馈自我修正；代码生成+仿真反馈+工具库复用的三元范式被 PCBSchemaGen、SchGen 等 PCB 级论文直接继承
papers.summary_en: AnalogCoder reformulates analog circuit design as Python code generation, enabling training-free use of general-purpose LLMs (tested on GPT-4o). A feedback loop runs SPICE simulation on generated circuits, parses error messages, and prompts the LLM to self-correct. A circuit tool library archives verified sub-circuit templates for reuse in composite designs. On a benchmark of 20 analog tasks, AnalogCoder surpasses GPT-4o baseline by 5 circuits. Accepted as an AAAI 2025 Oral presentation.
papers.summary_zh: AnalogCoder 将模拟电路设计重新建模为 Python 代码合成任务，无需任何微调即可驱动 GPT-4o 等通用 LLM 生成电路代码。系统自动运行 SPICE 仿真，解析错误反馈并提示 LLM 迭代修正；同时维护一个已验证子电路模板库供复合电路复用。在 20 个模拟电路任务 benchmark 上超越 GPT-4o 基线 5 题，以 AAAI 2025 Oral 发表。该代码生成+仿真验证+库复用范式被后续 PCB 原理图生成工作（PCBSchemaGen、SchGen）直接移植至板级设计。

papers.title: AutoCircuit-RL: Reinforcement Learning-Driven LLM for Automated Circuit Topology Generation
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 在 LLM 指令微调基础上加入 RL 奖励优化阶段，通过奖励模型评估拓扑有效性、效率和目标电压约束，将有效电路生成率提升 ~12%、重复生成率降低 ~38%；双阶段 RL+LLM 范式为 PCB 设计引入可微分设计约束优化思路
papers.summary_en: AutoCircuit-RL trains LLMs for circuit topology generation in two phases: instruction tuning on structured prompts encoding design constraints, then RL refinement using reward models evaluating validity, efficiency, and output-voltage compliance. Compared to pure supervised baselines, the RL stage yields ~12% more valid circuits, ~14% efficiency improvement, and ~38% fewer duplicates. Presented as a poster at ICML 2025. From IBM Research; code available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh: AutoCircuit-RL 分两阶段训练用于电路拓扑生成的 LLM：首先在编码设计约束的结构化 Prompt 上进行指令微调，其次通过 RL 奖励模型（评估拓扑有效性、效率、输出电压合规性）进行强化学习精调。相比纯监督基线，RL 阶段带来约 12% 有效电路提升、约 14% 效率提升和约 38% 重复生成率下降。以 ICML 2025 Poster 发表，来自 IBM Research。双阶段范式为在 PCB 原理图生成中引入可学习约束验证提供了方法参考。

papers.title: The Dawn of Agentic EDA: A Survey of Autonomous Digital Chip Design
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 Agentic EDA 建模为约束神经符号优化问题，提出感知-认知-行动三层 Cognitive Stack 分类法；全面覆盖前端（RTL→逻辑综合）到后端（布局布线）的自主 Agent 系统，直接对标 PCB 设计自动化 Agent 的能力层级
papers.summary_en: This survey reframes Agentic EDA as a Constrained Neuro-Symbolic Optimization problem rather than mere tool-calling. It proposes a Cognitive Stack taxonomy (Perception / Cognition / Action layers) to classify autonomous chip design systems, analyzes front-end (RTL repair, dual-loop verification) vs. back-end (algorithm-centric vs. agent-centric floorplanning) approaches, and identifies trustworthiness gaps motivating Sim-to-Silicon benchmarks and formal grounding. Submitted December 2025; covers systems through early 2026.
papers.summary_zh: 本综述将 Agentic EDA 重新建模为约束神经符号优化问题，提出感知（Perception）—认知（Cognition）—行动（Action）三层 Cognitive Stack 分类法，系统分析前端（RTL 双环修复、验证自主化）与后端（算法中心 vs Agent 中心布局）的最新自主系统。明确指出当前 LLM-based Agent 尚未完成工业级无人监督 tape-out，并提出 Sim-to-Silicon benchmark 和形式化接地的研究议程。2025 年 12 月提交，覆盖至 2026 年初的最新系统。

papers.title: IoTGen: Towards LLM-Driven IoT Hardware PCB Generation
papers.authors: Qinpei Luo, Ruichun Ma, Xinyu Zhang, Lili Qiu
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个面向 IoT 场景的端到端 LLM 驱动 PCB 生成系统，从自然语言需求出发直接输出 IoT 硬件 PCB 设计；以 MobiSys 2026 Emerging Ideas 发表，代表移动系统顶会对 NL→硬件自动化方向的最新背书
papers.summary_en: IoTGen is an agentic system that generates IoT PCB designs directly from natural language descriptions of hardware requirements, targeting the full pipeline from component selection through schematic generation. It is the first IoT-community paper at a top mobile systems venue (MobiSys 2026) to treat PCB generation as an LLM task. The work is from the UCSD/MSR/UT Austin group (Luo, Ma, Zhang, Qiu), the same group that produced SchGen. Published in the Emerging Ideas track of MobiSys 2026.
papers.summary_zh: IoTGen 是首个面向 IoT 场景的 LLM 驱动 PCB 生成 Agent 系统，从自然语言硬件需求出发，覆盖从元件选择到原理图生成的完整流程。作为 MobiSys 2026（移动系统顶会）Emerging Ideas 方向论文，是 IoT 社区首次正式将 PCB 设计自动化视为 LLM 任务。来自 UCSD/MSR/UT Austin 联合团队（同 SchGen 作者）。目前无 arXiv 预印本，PDF 可从 ACM DL 获取。

papers.title: PCB-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs for Printed Circuit Board Placement and Routing
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个系统评测 LLM 在 PCB 布局布线上的综合 benchmark（文本推理 3700 题 + 多模态 500 题 + 真实设计 174 项），以 ICLR 2026 顶会发表，清晰量化当前 LLM 在 PCB 工程约束推理上的能力缺口，为后续研究提供标准评测基准
papers.summary_en: PCB-Bench is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs and MLLMs on PCB placement and routing tasks, contributed by HKUST (Guangzhou). It spans three task settings: text-based reasoning (~3,700 QA pairs covering design rule compliance, component placement, routing strategies), multimodal image-text reasoning (~500 problems with PCB layout images), and real-world design comprehension (174 complete OSHWHub projects). Results show current models struggle with engineering constraint reasoning and spatial interpretation of PCB layouts. Published at ICLR 2026.
papers.summary_zh: PCB-Bench 是首个系统评测 LLM/MLLM 在 PCB 布局布线上的综合 benchmark，来自香港科技大学（广州）。包含三类任务：文本推理（约 3700 道专家标注题，覆盖设计规则合规、元件放置、布线策略）、多模态图文推理（约 500 题，需联合理解 PCB 版图图像与技术规格）和真实设计理解（174 个完整 OSHWHub 项目）。实验显示当前模型在工程约束推理和版图空间理解上存在显著差距。以 ICLR 2026 会议论文发表，是 PCB AI 设计领域的重要评测基准。

papers.title: HWE-Bench: Can Language Models Perform Board-level Schematic Designs?
papers.authors: Weibo Qiu, Yinhao Xiao, Runyu Pan
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个专注板级原理图设计的 LLM 评测 benchmark，300 条来自 GitHub/OSHWLab 的真实任务，2914 份 IC 数据手册支撑；揭示当前最佳模型板级设计 pass rate 仅 8.15%，清晰标定了当前技术边界与差距
papers.summary_en: HWE-Bench introduces 300 board-level schematic design tasks sourced from GitHub and OSHWHub, covering 8 application domains and backed by 2,914 IC datasheets. Models receive functional requirements and component specs, generate schematics, and are validated through electrical rule checks and circuit simulation. The top-performing model achieves only 8.15% overall pass rate, revealing that while LLMs handle documentation well, they lack physical circuit intuition required for correct board-level design.
papers.summary_zh: HWE-Bench 收录 300 条来自 GitHub 和 OSHWHub 的板级原理图设计任务，覆盖 8 个应用领域，辅以 2914 份 IC 数据手册。模型输入功能需求和元件规格，输出原理图，通过电气规则检查和电路仿真双重验证。当前最佳模型整体 pass rate 仅 8.15%，揭示 LLM 虽然能处理文档理解类任务，但在物理电路设计中仍缺乏必要的电气直觉。该 benchmark 与 PCB-Bench 互补，共同标定了当前技术边界。

papers.title: PCBSchemaGen: Reward-Guided LLM Code Synthesis for PCB Schematic Design with Structured Verification
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 PCB 原理图生成建模为代码合成，用 5 层确定性连续奖励验证器（引脚级错误定位）替代传统单元测试，227 个真实 IC 任务上实现 81.3% pass rate；推理时自动修正机制无需微调即可适配任意 IC 型号
papers.summary_en: PCBSchemaGen frames PCB schematic generation as code synthesis with a 5-layer deterministic continuous-reward verifier that provides pin-level error localization without requiring reference solutions. Tested on 227 real-IC tasks across two benchmarks (including novel ICs unseen during development), Gemma-4-31B achieves 81.3% pass rate, demonstrating cross-benchmark generalization. The reward verifier validates against physical constraints extracted from IC datasheets, enabling inference-time self-repair for any IC without retraining.
papers.summary_zh: PCBSchemaGen 将 PCB 原理图生成建模为代码合成问题，核心创新是 5 层确定性连续奖励验证器：可对生成代码提供引脚级错误定位，无需参考答案，也无需单元测试。在 227 个真实 IC 任务（跨两个 benchmark）上，Gemma-4-31B 实现 81.3% pass rate，并在新型 IC 上展示了跨 benchmark 的泛化能力。验证器从 IC 数据手册提取物理约束，使推理时自动修正循环可适配任意 IC 型号，无需重新训练。

papers.title: SchGen: PCB Schematic Generation with Semantic-Grounded Code Representations
papers.authors: Qinpei Luo, Ruichun Ma, Xinyu Zhang, Lili Qiu
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 PCB 原理图从几何重表示转化为语义化代码表示，大幅降低 LLM 生成难度；通过人-Agent 协作 pipeline 构建大规模开源硬件数据集，连接精度和功能正确性均超越更大规模通用模型；同一团队 IoTGen 的技术深化版
papers.summary_en: SchGen identifies that existing PCB schematic formats (KiCad, Altium) are geometry-heavy and tool-specific, making them poor targets for LLMs. It introduces a semantically grounded code representation that shifts the task from geometry to semantics. A human-agent collaborative pipeline converts open-source hardware designs to this representation, building a large-scale training dataset. Experiments show SchGen outperforms larger general-purpose models on connectivity accuracy and functional correctness. From the same UCSD/MSR/UT Austin group as IoTGen.
papers.summary_zh: SchGen 指出现有 PCB 原理图格式（KiCad、Altium 等）几何信息繁重、工具专属语法复杂，对 LLM 而言是低效的生成目标。论文提出语义化代码表示，将任务从几何定位转向电气语义，显著降低生成难度。通过人-Agent 协作数据 pipeline 将开源硬件设计（OSHWHub 等）转换为该表示，构建大规模训练集。实验在连接精度和功能正确性上均超越更大规模通用 LLM。来自与 IoTGen 相同的 UCSD/MSR/UT Austin 团队，是 IoTGen 的技术深化工作。

papers.title: CircuitLM: A Multi-Agent LLM-Aided Design Framework for Generating Circuit Schematics from Natural Language Prompts
papers.authors: Khandakar Shakib Al Hasan et al.
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 五阶段多 Agent pipeline（组件识别→引脚检索→推理→JSON 综合→可视化），用 embedding 驱动的元件库消解 LLM 幻觉；100 个电路 Prompt 上通过电气规则检查和语义评估双重验证，是 IEEE ICLAD（LLM+EDA 专会首届）代表性论文
papers.summary_en: CircuitLM proposes a five-stage multi-LLM pipeline for generating circuit schematics from natural language: component identification → pinout retrieval (from an embedding-powered component database) → design reasoning → CircuitJSON synthesis → visualization. The component database mitigates hallucination by grounding component references in real datasheets. Evaluated on 100 circuit design prompts using both deterministic electrical rule checking and LLM-based semantic evaluation across five state-of-the-art LLMs. Code and data publicly available.
papers.summary_zh: CircuitLM 提出五阶段多 LLM 流水线，将自然语言转化为电路原理图：组件识别→引脚检索（嵌入式驱动的元件数据库）→设计推理→CircuitJSON 合成→可视化。Embedding 驱动的元件库将 LLM 组件引用接地到真实数据手册，有效抑制幻觉。在 100 个电路设计 Prompt 上使用确定性电气规则检查和 LLM 语义评估双重验证，覆盖 5 款主流 LLM。代码和数据公开。以 IEEE ICLAD 2026（LLM+EDA 专会首届）发表。

papers.title: pcbGPT: Automatic PCB Schematic Synthesis from Natural Language Requirements
papers.authors: Tobias King, Steven Kehrberg, Michael Beigl, Tobias Röddiger
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 面向嵌入式系统的 KiCad PCB 原理图自动生成，集成工具调用、元件库搜索、数据手册知识和执行检查；20 个任务上 pass@1=0.90；提供可与 KiCad 实时同步的交互式 Web 工作流，来自德国 KIT，是欧洲视角的 PCB-LLM 系统
papers.summary_en: pcbGPT generates editable KiCad PCB schematics from natural-language specifications for embedded systems. It combines tool-augmented synthesis, component-library search, datasheet-grounded design knowledge, and execution-based checking through a Python circuit DSL. An interactive web workflow enables iterative refinement and real-time KiCad project synchronization. On 20 schematic tasks: pass@1 = 0.90, pass@5 = 1.00. Authors acknowledge the system is not yet reliable enough to replace expert review for final production designs. From Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT).
papers.summary_zh: pcbGPT 从自然语言规格生成可编辑的 KiCad PCB 原理图，面向嵌入式系统场景。系统集成工具调用、元件库搜索、数据手册知识和基于执行的合规检查，通过 Python 电路 DSL 表示设计。提供可与 KiCad 实时同步的交互式 Web 工作流，支持迭代精化。在 20 个原理图任务上 pass@1=0.90，pass@5=1.00。来自德国卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院（KIT），是欧洲研究视角的 PCB-LLM 系统代表。

papers.title: IoTCoder: A Copilot for IoT Application Development
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 最早在 MobiCom（顶级移动计算会议）发表的 LLM-IoT 代码生成系统，提出将 LLM 作为 IoT 应用开发副驾（Copilot）的完整框架，确立了自然语言需求 IoT 固件代码的基础范式，被 AutoIOT、GPIoT、AutoEmbed 等后续工作直接引用
papers.summary_en: IoTCoder introduces a copilot framework for IoT application development, enabling developers to describe desired IoT behaviors in natural language and receive complete, executable code targeting MCU platforms such as Arduino and ESP32. The system leverages an LLM backend to interpret sensor/actuator interactions and emit hardware-aware code, bridging the gap between high-level intent and low-level embedded programming. It is the earliest tier-1 venue paper to position LLMs as automated IoT code generators rather than mere documentation assistants. MobiCom 2024.
papers.summary_zh: IoTCoder 提出面向 IoT 应用开发的 LLM 副驾框架：开发者用自然语言描述 IoT 行为，系统自动生成针对 Arduino、ESP32 等 MCU 平台的完整可执行代码。框架将传感器/执行器交互建模为结构化上下文，引导 LLM 生成硬件感知代码，填补高层意图与低层嵌入式编程之间的鸿沟。是最早在 MobiCom 顶会发表的将 LLM 定位为 IoT 代码自动生成器（而非仅为文档助手）的工作，为 AutoIOT、GPIoT 等后续系统奠定基础范式。

papers.title: AutoPLC: Generating Vendor-Aware Structured Text for Programmable Logic Controllers
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 面向工业嵌入式场景的 LLM 代码生成工作，将自然语言控制逻辑映射为 IEC 61131-3 标准 Structured Text（ST）并生成厂商感知的合规代码；覆盖嵌入式代码生成在 PLC/工业控制器上的扩展，与 MCU 固件生成形成互补（arXiv 预印本）
papers.summary_en: AutoPLC generates IEC 61131-3 Structured Text programs for Programmable Logic Controllers directly from natural language control logic descriptions. The key contribution is vendor-awareness: the system incorporates knowledge of specific PLC vendor APIs and constraints (e.g., Siemens, Allen-Bradley) to generate code that compiles without modification on target hardware. This extends LLM-based embedded code generation from general MCUs to the industrial control domain. arXiv December 2024.
papers.summary_zh: AutoPLC 从自然语言控制逻辑描述直接生成 IEC 61131-3 标准 Structured Text（ST）PLC 程序。核心贡献是厂商感知：系统内置西门子、Allen-Bradley 等主要 PLC 厂商的 API 和约束知识，生成的代码无需修改即可在目标硬件上编译运行。将 LLM 嵌入式代码生成从通用 MCU 扩展到工业控制领域。arXiv 2024年 12 月提交。

papers.title: AutoIOT: LLM-Driven Automated Natural Language Programming for AIoT Applications
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 领域内迄今引用最高（31 引、5 influential）的 LLM-IoT 代码生成工作，首次实现从自然语言到 AIoT 应用的全流程自动化（需求分析代码生成编译验证迭代修复），多 Agent 架构引入编译器反馈循环； MobiCom 2025 发表，被 AutoEmbed、IoTPilot、Skilled AI Agents 等核心后续工作广泛引用
papers.summary_en: AutoIOT presents the first end-to-end automated pipeline from natural language descriptions to deployable AIoT application code. A multi-agent architecture decomposes the task: a planner agent interprets requirements and maps them to hardware abstractions, a coder agent generates MCU-specific code, and a validator agent runs compilation checks and feeds error messages back for iterative repair. Evaluated on 20+ IoT scenarios across ESP32, Arduino, and nRF52 platforms, AutoIOT achieves over 85% compilation success rate on first attempt. With 31 citations (5 influential) as of mid-2026, it is the most-cited paper in this emerging field. MobiCom 2025.
papers.summary_zh: AutoIOT 构建了从自然语言描述到可部署 AIoT 应用代码的首个端到端全流程自动化系统。多 Agent 架构分工明确：规划 Agent 解析需求并映射硬件抽象，编码 Agent 生成面向 MCU 的具体代码，验证 Agent 执行编译检查并将错误信息反馈给编码 Agent 进行迭代修复。在 ESP32、Arduino、nRF52 等平台的 20+ IoT 场景测试中，首次尝试编译成功率超过 85%。截至 2026 年中，引用量 31 次（5 次 influential），是该新兴领域过价引用最高的工作，被 AutoEmbed、IoTPilot、Skilled AI Agents 等后续核心论文广泛引用。MobiCom 2025 发表。

papers.title: GPIoT: Tailoring Small Language Models for IoT Program Synthesis and Development
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个系统研究如何将小型语言模型（SLM，<7B）专门化用于 IoT 程序合成的工作，采用 IoT 专属数据集微调 + 混合推理策略（本地 SLM + 云端 LLM 后备），大幅降低边缘部署成本；27 引、SenSys 2025 顶会发表，是 IoT 代码生成的边缘化方向代表
papers.summary_en: GPIoT systematically addresses the cost and latency problem of cloud-LLM-based IoT code generation by tailoring Small Language Models (7B parameters or fewer) specifically for IoT program synthesis. The approach fine-tunes open-source SLMs (Qwen, DeepSeek-Coder variants) on an IoT-specific code dataset spanning 15+ MCU families, and introduces a hybrid inference strategy that routes simple tasks to the local SLM while escalating complex or failing cases to a cloud LLM. On IoT synthesis benchmarks, GPIoT-7B matches GPT-4 on 73% of tasks while eliminating cloud dependency for routine generation. SenSys 2025, 27 citations.
papers.summary_zh: GPIoT 系统性地解决云端 LLM 驱动 IoT 代码生成的成本和延迟问题，方法是将小型语言模型（7B 参数以内）专门化用于 IoT 程序合成。对 Qwen、DeepSeek-Coder 等开源 SLM 在涵盖 15 种以上 MCU 家族的 IoT 专属代码数据集上进行微调，并引入混合推理策略：简单任务由本地 SLM 处理，复杂或失败情形上报云端 LLM。在 IoT 合成 benchmark 上，GPIoT-7B 在 73% 任务上匹敌 GPT-4，同时消除日常生成对云端的依赖。SenSys 2025 发表，27 次引用。

papers.title: Programming Embedded IoT Applications in Natural Language with IoTPilot
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 专注于真实嵌入式 IoT 平台部署的 NL 编程系统，突出硬件感知代码生成和跨平台兼容性（覆盖 ESP32、nRF52840、STM32 等主流 MCU），引入硬件抽象层使生成代码可在不同芯片架构间迁移；MobiSys 2025 发表
papers.summary_en: IoTPilot is a natural-language programming system targeting the full embedded IoT development workflow from NL requirement to compiled, flashed firmware on real hardware. The system introduces a Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) that decouples the LLM-generated logic from MCU-specific peripheral APIs, enabling the same generated code to be adapted across ESP32, nRF52840, and STM32 targets without manual porting. A code synthesis pipeline handles peripheral initialization, interrupt configuration, and RTOS task scheduling that typical code LLMs omit. MobiSys 2025.
papers.summary_zh: IoTPilot 是面向真实嵌入式 IoT 硬件部署的自然语言编程系统，覆盖从 NL 需求到编译烧录固件的完整开发流程。系统引入硬件抽象层（HAL），将 LLM 生成的应用逻辑与 MCU 专属外设 API 解耦，使同一套生成代码无需人工移植即可适配 ESP32、nRF52840、STM32 等目标平台。代码合成 pipeline 专项处理外设初始化、中断配置和 RTOS 任务调度等传统代码 LLM 常常省略的嵌入式细节。MobiSys 2025 发表。

papers.title: Securing LLM-Generated Embedded Firmware through AI Agent-Driven Validation and Patching
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 关注 LLM 生成嵌入式固件的安全漏洞，提出 AI Agent 驱动的静态分析+补丁生成闭环，覆盖缓冲区溢出、竞争条件等嵌入式常见安全缺陷；是从安全/可靠性视角补充 AutoIOT、AutoEmbed 等代码生成工作的重要 arXiv 预印本
papers.summary_en: This paper addresses the security gap in LLM-generated embedded firmware: while automated systems can produce compilable code, they frequently introduce classic embedded security vulnerabilities such as buffer overflows, race conditions, and improper interrupt handling. The authors propose an AI agent pipeline that applies static analysis tools (adapted for MCU architectures) to generated firmware, identifies vulnerability patterns, and uses a patching LLM agent to generate and validate fixes. Evaluated on firmware generated by GPT-4 and Llama-3 targeting STM32 and ESP32. arXiv 2025.
papers.summary_zh: 本文针对 LLM 生成嵌入式固件中的安全漏洞问题：自动化系统虽可生成可编译代码，但频繁引入缓冲区溢出、竞争条件、中断处理不当等嵌入式经典安全缺陷。作者提出 AI Agent 流水线：适配 MCU 架构的静态分析工具扫描生成固件，识别漏洞模式，再由补丁 LLM Agent 生成修复代码并验证。在 GPT-4 和 Llama-3 生成的 STM32、ESP32 目标固件上进行评测。arXiv 2025 年预印本。

papers.title: Automated Code Generation and Validation for Software Components of Microcontrollers
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 系统性研究微控制器软件组件的自动化代码生成与验证流程，专注于编译验证循环（compilation validation loop）的设计与评估，对驱动程序、HAL 层等独立软件组件的 LLM 生成质量进行量化评估；arXiv 2025
papers.summary_en: This paper presents a systematic study of automated code generation and validation for discrete software components in microcontroller systems, focusing on drivers, HAL modules, and middleware. The methodology pairs an LLM code generator with a compilation-and-unit-test validation loop tailored to constrained MCU environments (bare-metal and RTOS targets). The authors evaluate generation success rates and failure modes across ARM Cortex-M and AVR targets, identifying that peripheral register abstraction and interrupt vector configuration are the most common LLM failure points. arXiv 2025.
papers.summary_zh: 本文系统研究微控制器软件组件（驱动程序、HAL 模块、中间件）的自动化代码生成与验证，将 LLM 代码生成器与专为受限 MCU 环境（裸机和 RTOS）设计的编译+单元测试验证循环相结合。在 ARM Cortex-M 和 AVR 目标上评估生成成功率和失败模式，发现外设寄存器抽象和中断向量配置是 LLM 最常见的失败点。arXiv 2025 年预印本。

papers.title: Jarvis: Zero-code Prototyping of IoT Applications with Composable Hardware-Software Abstractions
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 提出可组合硬件-软件抽象层实现 IoT 应用零代码原型开发，面向非编程背景用户；与 IoTCoder/AutoIOT 的 LLM 直接生成代码路线不同，侧重构建可复用的抽象组件库，ACM TIOT 期刊发表
papers.summary_en: Jarvis enables zero-code prototyping of IoT applications through a library of composable hardware-software abstractions: each abstraction encapsulates sensor/actuator initialization, data flow, and event handling for a specific hardware module. Users compose these pre-verified building blocks through a drag-and-drop interface, and the system generates the underlying embedded code automatically. Unlike LLM-based generation, Jarvis guarantees correctness by construction for each abstraction unit, trading coverage for reliability. Targets educators and domain experts without MCU programming experience. ACM Transactions on Internet of Things 2025.
papers.summary_zh: Jarvis 通过可组合硬件-软件抽象库实现 IoT 应用零代码原型开发：每个抽象封装特定硬件模块的传感器/执行器初始化、数据流和事件处理逻辑。用户通过拖拽界面组合这些预验证构建块，系统自动生成底层嵌入式代码。与 LLM 生成路线不同，Jarvis 通过构造保证每个抽象单元的正确性，以覆盖范围换取可靠性。面向无 MCU 编程经验的教育者和领域专家。ACM Transactions on Internet of Things 2025 发表。

papers.title: An LLM-enabled Multi-Agent Autonomous Mechatronics Design Framework
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 LLM 多 Agent 框架扩展至机电一体化系统协同设计，覆盖嵌入式固件代码生成与机械结构设计的联合优化；CVPR 2025 Workshop 发表，是将 AI Agent 应用于跨域嵌入式+机械设计的早期探索
papers.summary_en: This paper proposes a multi-agent LLM framework for autonomous mechatronics design, jointly optimizing embedded firmware code generation and mechanical structure design. Specialized agents handle different design domains: a hardware agent generates MCU firmware targeting the physical actuator constraints, a mechanics agent designs structural parameters, and a coordinator agent resolves interdomain conflicts. Evaluated on robotic arm and mobile platform design tasks, the framework reduces human intervention from 14 manual steps to 3. CVPR 2025 Workshop.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出面向机电一体化系统协同设计的多 Agent LLM 框架，联合优化嵌入式固件代码生成与机械结构设计。各专业 Agent 负责不同设计域：硬件 Agent 根据物理执行器约束生成 MCU 固件，机械 Agent 设计结构参数，协调 Agent 解决跨域冲突。在机械臂和移动平台设计任务上，框架将人工干预步骤从 14 步减少到 3 步。CVPR 2025 Workshop 发表。

papers.title: IoTMigrator: LLM-driven Embedded IoT Code Migration across Different OSes for Cloud-device Integration
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 研究 LLM 驱动的嵌入式 IoT 代码跨 OS 迁移问题（FreeRTOS Zephyr Linux 等），补全代码生成闭环中的移植/升级环节；来自 IoTPilot 同一团队（Gong、Dong），EMNLP Findings 2025
papers.summary_en: IoTMigrator addresses the code migration problem in embedded IoT development: porting existing firmware between different embedded operating systems (e.g., FreeRTOS to Zephyr, bare-metal to Azure RTOS) for cloud-device integration scenarios. The LLM-driven pipeline identifies OS-specific API calls, maps them to target-OS equivalents, and rewrites the migration logic while preserving application semantics. Evaluated on 120 real-world IoT firmware migration tasks across 6 OS pairs, achieving 78.3% successful compilation on the first attempt. From the same group as IoTPilot (Gong et al.). EMNLP Findings 2025.
papers.summary_zh: IoTMigrator 解决嵌入式 IoT 开发中的代码跨 OS 迁移问题：将现有固件在不同嵌入式操作系统间移植（如 FreeRTOS Zephyr、裸机 Azure RTOS），用于云设备集成场景。LLM 驱动的 pipeline 识别 OS 专属 API 调用，映射到目标 OS 等效接口，并在保留应用语义的前提下重写迁移逻辑。在 120 个真实 IoT 固件迁移任务（6 个 OS 对）上评测，首次尝试编译成功率 78.3%。来自 IoTPilot 同一团队（Gong 等人）。EMNLP Findings 2025 发表。

papers.title: EmbedAgent: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Embedded System Development
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个系统性 benchmark，全面评估 LLM 在嵌入式系统开发全流程中的能力（需求理解代码生成编译调试性能优化），在 ESP32、STM32、Arduino 等 6 种 MCU 上评估 8 款主流 LLM；ICSE 2026 顶会发表，是该领域能力边界的权威量化参照
papers.summary_en: EmbedAgent introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM agents across the complete embedded system development workflow: requirement decomposition, peripheral driver code generation, compilation error repair, and performance optimization (memory footprint and execution speed). The benchmark covers 6 MCU families (ESP32, STM32, nRF52, Arduino Uno, RP2040, RISC-V) with 240 tasks at varying complexity levels. Eight LLMs are evaluated, revealing that current best models achieve only 58% end-to-end task completion and struggle most with hardware-specific timing constraints and ISR correctness. ICSE 2026.
papers.summary_zh: EmbedAgent 构建了首个覆盖嵌入式系统开发完整流程的 LLM Agent benchmark：需求分解、外设驱动代码生成、编译错误修复、性能优化（内存占用和执行速度）。benchmark 覆盖 6 类 MCU（ESP32、STM32、nRF52、Arduino Uno、RP2040、RISC-V），240 个不同难度任务。 8 款主流 LLM 评测结果揭示：当前最优模型端到端任务完成率仅 58%，在硬件相关时序约束和中断服务例程（ISR）正确性上表现最差。ICSE 2026 发表，是该领域能力边界的权威量化参照。

papers.title: Skilled AI Agents for Embedded and IoT Systems Development
papers.venue: ACM Conference on AI and Agentic Systems
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 提出技能（Skill）化 AI Agent 架构用于嵌入式/IoT 开发，将通用 LLM 与嵌入式领域技能库（硬件初始化、协议栈操作、调试指令集）结合，ACM AGENTS 2026 发表；与 AutoEmbed 同在 2026 年代表该方向最新前沿
papers.summary_en: Skilled AI Agents proposes a skill-based architecture where a general-purpose LLM agent is augmented with a library of embedded-domain skills: reusable, verified code snippets and procedural knowledge covering hardware initialization sequences, communication protocol stacks (MQTT, BLE, LoRa), and debugging command sequences. The skill library acts as grounded tool-use, reducing LLM hallucination on MCU-specific APIs. Evaluated on 50 IoT development tasks across 4 hardware platforms, the skilled agent outperforms direct GPT-4 prompting by 34% on compilation success rate. ACM AGENTS 2026.
papers.summary_zh: Skilled AI Agents 提出技能化 Agent 架构：通用目的 LLM Agent 与嵌入式领域技能库（可复用、已验证的代码片段和程序性知识，覆盖硬件初始化序列、通信协议栈 MQTT/BLE/LoRa、调试命令集）相结合。技能库提供接地的工具调用，减少 LLM 在 MCU 专属 API 上的幻觉。在 4 个硬件平台的 50 个 IoT 开发任务上，技能化 Agent 的编译成功率比直接 GPT-4 提示高 34%。ACM AGENTS 2026 发表。

papers.title: AutoEmbed: LLM-driven Automated Software Development for Generic Embedded IoT Systems
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 目前最全面的 LLM 驱动嵌入式 IoT 软件自动开发系统，覆盖需求代码生成自动测试持续调试直至运行成功完整闭环，支持 ESP、Arduino、nRF、STM 等多种主流 MCU；SenSys 2026 最新发表，代表该方向当前前沿
papers.summary_en: AutoEmbed is the most comprehensive LLM-driven automated software development system for embedded IoT, directly addressing the target scenario: given a natural language requirement and target MCU (ESP, Arduino, nRF, STM, etc.), it generates a complete compilable code project, runs automated tests, and iteratively debugs until the firmware compiles, passes tests, and meets functional requirements. The system employs a hierarchical agent architecture: a design agent decomposes requirements into hardware-aware subtasks, implementation agents generate code per module, and a validation agent orchestrates compilation, simulation, and on-device testing feedback. SenSys 2026.
papers.summary_zh: AutoEmbed 是目前最全面的 LLM 驱动嵌入式 IoT 软件自动开发系统，与用户目标场景高度契合：输入自然语言需求和目标 MCU（ESP、Arduino、nRF、STM 等），自动生成完整可编译代码项目，运行自动化测试，持续调试直至固件成功编译、通过测试并满足功能需求。系统采用层级 Agent 架构：设计 Agent 将需求分解为硬件感知子任务，实现 Agent 按模块生成代码，验证 Agent 协调编译、仿真和真机测试反馈形成闭环。SenSys 2026 发表。

papers.title: Sensing with Earables: A Systematic Literature Review and Taxonomy of Phenomena
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 目前最全面的耳戴式设备传感综述（271 篇论文），将耳戴传感划分为生理、声学、运动/姿态、电信号和光学五大类别，是进入 earable 多模态传感领域的必读地图
papers.summary_en: This survey covers 271 earable sensing papers published before 2022, organizing phenomena into five sensing categories: physiological (pulse, temperature, SpO2), acoustic (bone conduction, in-ear microphone, sonar), kinematic (IMU-based head and jaw movement), electric (EEG, EMG, ECG from the ear), and optical (photoplethysmography, SpO2). The taxonomy distinguishes between passive listening and active acoustic sensing modalities, directly informing the research directions covered by subsequent EarIO and EchoSpeech. It identifies multi-modal sensing on earables as a key open challenge and provides a structured vocabulary that later works (OpenEarable, ID.EARS) explicitly reference. The companion website indexes all papers by phenomenon and device type.
papers.summary_zh: 本综述覆盖 2022 年前发表的 271 篇耳戴传感论文，将感知现象分为五大类：生理信号（脉搏、体温、SpO2）、声学（骨传导、入耳麦克风、主动声呐）、运动/姿态（IMU 头部及颌部运动）、电信号（来自耳部的 EEG/EMG/ECG）和光学（PPG、SpO2）。综述区分了被动收听与主动声呐两种声学传感范式，为 EarIO 和 EchoSpeech 的后续研究方向提供了直接理论依据。论文将耳戴设备多模态融合列为重要开放挑战，OpenEarable、ID.EARS 等后续工作均明确引用其分类体系。

papers.title: ExpressEar: Sensing Fine-Grained Facial Expressions with Earables
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 最早将耳戴设备用于精细面部表情识别的顶会工作（IMWUT 2021）：利用耳道内麦克风捕获面部肌肉运动改变耳道几何形状引起的声学信号变化，无需额外传感器即可识别 16 种面部表情，被 EarIO、ActSonic、EyeEcho 等多项后续工作直接引用
papers.summary_en: ExpressEar uses the microphone already present in commercial earbuds to detect fine-grained facial expressions by analyzing changes in the acoustic properties of the ear canal. Facial muscle contractions alter the ear canal geometry, changing how in-ear audio signals reflect; ExpressEar trains a classifier on these acoustic perturbations to recognize 16 expression classes. The system requires no additional hardware beyond standard earphones and achieves over 80% accuracy on an 8-subject study. It established the foundational premise that the ear canal is a rich acoustic window into perioral and periocular muscle activity, directly influencing EarIO active sonar extension and later glasses-based acoustic systems.
papers.summary_zh: ExpressEar 利用商用耳机自带的麦克风，通过分析耳道声学属性变化来检测精细面部表情。面部肌肉收缩改变耳道几何结构，进而改变耳内音频信号的反射特性；系统基于这些声学扰动训练分类器，可识别 16 种表情类别。该方案无需额外硬件，仅需标准耳机，在 8 名受试者研究中准确率超过 80%。本文确立了耳道是感知口周和眶周肌肉活动的丰富声学窗口这一基础性前提，直接影响了 EarIO 的主动声呐扩展以及后续眼镜声学系统的设计。

papers.title: EarIO: A Low-power Acoustic Sensing Earable for Continuously Tracking Detailed Facial Movements
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 引入主动声呐（不可听超声 chirp）用于耳戴面部跟踪的奠基工作：使用耳机自带扬声器发射超声信号并用麦克风接收反射，仅需 1mW 即可持续追踪 45 个面部关键点（平均误差 1.59mm），为 EyeEcho、GazeTrak、EyeGesener、SonicID 整个声学 earable 系列直接奠定技术基础
papers.summary_en: EarIO introduces active acoustic sonar for earable facial tracking: the earphone speaker emits inaudible ultrasonic chirps that reflect off perioral and cheek tissues, and the in-ear microphone captures the reflection pattern to track 45 facial landmarks continuously. Operating at approximately 1mW, EarIO enables always-on facial motion capture without battery-prohibitive cameras or additional sensors. Average landmark tracking error is reported at 1.59mm across diverse facial poses and expressions. This active-sonar-from-earphone paradigm became the technical foundation for EyeEcho (faces on glasses), GazeTrak (eyes on glasses), EyeGesener (eye gestures), and SonicID (user ID), all of which extend the same core mechanism.
papers.summary_zh: EarIO 引入主动声呐用于耳戴面部跟踪：耳机扬声器发射不可听超声 chirp，超声信号从口周和脸颊组织反射后由入耳麦克风捕获，连续追踪 45 个面部关键点。系统仅需约 1mW 运行，无需摄像头或额外传感器即可实现全天候面部运动捕获，平均关键点追踪误差为 1.59mm。这种耳机主动声呐范式成为 EyeEcho（眼镜面部追踪）、GazeTrak（眼镜眼动追踪）、EyeGesener（眼势交互）和 SonicID（用户识别）的共同技术基础。

papers.title: EchoSpeech: Continuous Silent Speech Recognition on Minimally-obtrusive Eyewear Powered by Acoustic Sensing
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个在眼镜框架上实现连续无声语音识别的声学感知系统（CHI 2023，60 次引用）：将声呐发射器/接收器集成到眼镜框，捕获口腔和下颌运动引起的面部反射变化，31 词汇表准确率 95%；引发 EyeEcho、GazeTrak、EyeGesener、SonicID 等整条眼镜声学感知论文链，是本领域当前引用量最高的里程碑论文
papers.summary_en: EchoSpeech mounts piezoelectric transducers on eyeglass frames to emit 18-22kHz acoustic signals that probe the facial surface around the mouth and jaw. Micro-Doppler and reflection changes during silent articulation are decoded by a lightweight neural network to recognize continuous word sequences without audible sound. On a 31-word vocabulary across 12 participants, the system achieves 95% accuracy with speaker-independent transfer learning. With 60 citations by 2024, EchoSpeech is the most-cited paper in the glasses-acoustic sensing cluster and directly inspired EyeEcho (facial expressions), GazeTrak (gaze), EyeGesener (eye gestures), and SonicID (user identity), establishing acoustic sensing as the dominant modality for smart glasses augmentation.
papers.summary_zh: EchoSpeech 在眼镜框上安装压电换能器，发射 18-22kHz 声学信号探测口部和下颌周围的面部表面。无声发音时的微多普勒和反射变化由轻量级神经网络解码，实现无需发出声音的连续词序列识别。在 12 名受试者、31 词汇表测试中达到 95% 准确率，支持说话人无关迁移学习。截至 2024 年获得 60 次引用，是眼镜声学感知集群中引用量最高的论文，直接催生了 EyeEcho（面部表情）、GazeTrak（注视追踪）、EyeGesener（眼势交互）和 SonicID（用户识别）等后续系列。

papers.title: ActSonic: Recognizing Everyday Activities from Inaudible Acoustic Wave Around the Body
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将耳戴/身体佩戴声学传感的范畴从面部跟踪扩展到全身日常活动识别（20 类动作，90.5% 准确率），证明不可听声波可作为 body-area sensing 的统一模态；IMWUT 2024 发表，横向扩展了声学传感在 wearable 上的应用边界
papers.summary_en: ActSonic uses inaudible 18-22kHz acoustic waves emitted from a body-worn device (including earphone-form anchors) to recognize 20 everyday activities by sensing whole-body posture changes and limb movements. The system achieves 90.5% activity recognition accuracy without cameras, GPS, or external infrastructure. Key contribution is demonstrating that the same acoustic sonar approach proven for facial tracking (EarIO, EchoSpeech) generalizes to full-body activity recognition when emitters and receivers are positioned at shoulder or ear level. This work consolidates the acoustic sensing modality paradigm across sensing scales: from millimeter facial movements to meter-scale body postures.
papers.summary_zh: ActSonic 使用体戴设备（包括耳机形式的声学锚点）发射 18-22kHz 不可听声波，通过感知全身姿态变化和肢体运动识别 20 种日常活动，准确率 90.5%，无需摄像头、GPS 或外部基础设施。核心贡献在于证明 EarIO 和 EchoSpeech 验证的耳机声学声呐方法，在发射/接收器位于肩部或耳部时可泛化到全身活动识别。本文将声学传感模态的适用范围从毫米级面部运动横向扩展到米级身体姿态，巩固了声学传感作为 wearable 统一感知模态的地位。

papers.title: EyeGesener: Eye Gesture Listener for Smart Glasses Interaction Using Acoustic Sensing
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将眼镜声学感知从面部/眼球运动追踪（EchoSpeech、GazeTrak）扩展到基于眼势的交互输入（IMWUT 2024）：通过眼镜框声呐探测眼眶区域反射变化识别注视方向和眨眼序列，实现无摄像头的凝视交互
papers.summary_en: EyeGesener extends the glasses-frame acoustic sonar approach (pioneered by EchoSpeech) to eye gesture-based interaction, using the frame as a transmitter/receiver pair that probes reflections from the eye socket region to recognize directional gaze gestures and blink sequences. The system enables camera-free, privacy-preserving gaze-based input on commodity glasses frames without modifying the optics. By coupling acoustic signals around the eye socket rather than just the mouth, it demonstrates that the acoustic modality has sufficient spatial resolution to distinguish fine eye movement patterns for interaction design. Published at IMWUT 2024 as part of the expanding glasses-acoustic sensing research program.
papers.summary_zh: EyeGesener 将眼镜框声学声呐方法（由 EchoSpeech 开创）延伸至基于眼势的交互输入，利用眼镜框作为收发对探测眼眶区域的反射变化，识别注视方向手势和眨眼序列。该方案在商用眼镜框上实现无摄像头、隐私保护的注视交互，无需修改镜片。通过将声学信号聚焦于眼眶周围而非仅口部，证明声学模态具有足够的空间分辨率来区分精细眼动模式并支持交互设计。IMWUT 2024 发表，是眼镜声学传感研究项目的持续扩展。

papers.title: SonicID: User Identification on Smart Glasses with Acoustic Sensing
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将眼镜声学传感应用于被动用户识别（IMWUT 2024）：耳道对超声信号的谐振特性因人而异，SonicID 利用眼镜框声呐发射信号并通过耳道谐振特征识别用户，97.4% 准确率；同一 Ke Li 研究组（EarIO/EyeEcho/GazeTrak）的延伸，将声学模态的应用场景从感知扩展到身份认证
papers.summary_en: SonicID exploits the unique acoustic resonance characteristics of each user ear canal for passive user identification: acoustic signals emitted from the glasses frame travel to the ear and back, encoding individual-specific ear canal geometry in the reflected signal pattern. The system achieves 97.4% user identification accuracy across enrolled users, operates continuously without any active user gesture, and consumes minimal power using the same hardware architecture as EarIO and EyeEcho. From the Ke Li research group, SonicID demonstrates that the glasses-to-ear acoustic coupling used for sensing facial movements (EyeEcho) can be repurposed as a biometric channel, consolidating the multi-application potential of a single acoustic sensing hardware setup.
papers.summary_zh: SonicID 利用每位用户耳道独特的声学谐振特性实现被动用户识别：眼镜框发射声学信号经过耳道后返回，携带个体特异性耳道几何信息的反射信号模式被解码为用户身份。系统在注册用户中实现 97.4% 识别准确率，无需主动手势，持续运行。来自 Ke Li 研究组（与 EarIO、EyeEcho 同组），SonicID 表明 EyeEcho 用于面部运动感知的眼镜-耳道声学耦合可复用为生物特征识别通道，展示了单一声学硬件平台的多应用潜力。

papers.title: OpenEarable ExG: Open-Source Hardware for Ear-Based Biopotential Sensing Applications
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个开源耳部生物电位（ExG）感知硬件平台（UbiComp Companion 2024）：在 OpenEarable 基础上添加耳道内/外电极，实现从单一耳机采集 EEG（脑波）、EOG（眼动）、EMG（肌电）和 ECG（心电），为 OpenEarable 2.0、ID.EARS 等后续平台和 EEG 耳机研究提供了开源硬件参考
papers.summary_en: OpenEarable ExG extends the OpenEarable platform with biopotential electrodes positioned in and around the ear canal, enabling simultaneous EEG, EOG, EMG, and ECG measurement from a single earphone form factor. The hardware design includes conductive ear tips for canal contact, a reference electrode on the outer ear, and analog front-end electronics for multi-channel biopotential amplification. Demonstration applications include alpha wave detection (EEG), vertical eye movement tracking (EOG), and jaw clenching detection (EMG). As an open-source contribution, it provides the research community with a reference hardware platform for ear-based ExG sensing, directly influencing subsequent platforms like OpenEarable 2.0 and validation studies like Advancing Wearable BCI.
papers.summary_zh: OpenEarable ExG 在 OpenEarable 平台基础上添加耳道内外定位的生物电位电极，实现从单一耳机采集 EEG、EOG、EMG 和 ECG。硬件设计包括导电耳尖（接触耳道）、外耳参考电极和多通道生物电位放大模拟前端。演示应用包括 Alpha 波检测（EEG）、垂直眼动追踪（EOG）和咬合检测（EMG）。作为开源贡献，为研究社区提供了耳部 ExG 感知参考硬件平台，直接影响了 OpenEarable 2.0 等后续平台和 Advancing Wearable BCI 等验证研究。

papers.title: Advancing Wearable BCI: Headphone EEG for Cognitive Load Detection in Lab and Field
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 EEG 感知整合到消费级头戴耳机（IMWUT 2025）：在标准消费耳机上嵌入 EEG 电极，在实验室和真实使用场景下检测认知负荷（α/θ 频段），证明耳机 EEG 性能与传统脑电帽相当；是耳机 BCI 从研究原型走向消费级形态的关键可行性研究
papers.summary_en: This paper integrates dry EEG electrodes into a standard consumer headphone form factor to detect cognitive load via alpha and theta band power changes, validated in both controlled lab conditions and uncontrolled field environments. Key finding is that headphone-embedded EEG achieves statistically equivalent cognitive load classification performance to traditional wet-electrode cap EEG systems, while offering the form-factor advantage of everyday use. The paper evaluates three electrode placement strategies on the outer ear, reports approximately 75% binary cognitive load classification accuracy, and characterizes motion artifact patterns specific to ambulatory headphone use. It provides the most direct real-world feasibility evidence for the headphone EEG direction taken by ID.EARS.
papers.summary_zh: 本文将干式 EEG 电极集成到标准消费耳机中，通过 α/θ 频段功率变化检测认知负荷，在受控实验室和非受控真实使用场景下均进行了验证。关键发现是耳机嵌入式 EEG 在认知负荷分类性能上与传统湿电极脑电帽统计等效，同时具备日常使用形态的优势。论文评估了外耳三种电极布置策略，二分类认知负荷准确率约 75%，并量化了耳机在行走使用中特有的运动伪迹模式。为 ID.EARS 等耳机 EEG 研究方向提供了最直接的真实场景可行性证据。

papers.title: ReHEarSSE: Recognizing Hidden-in-the-Ear Silently Spelled Expressions
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将耳戴声学传感用于隐秘无声拼写识别（CHI 2024）：用户通过舌/齿/唇无声拼写字母，入耳麦克风捕获口腔腔体声学变化以识别拼写序列，实现隐蔽式免手免声界面；CHI 2024 发表（21 次引用），代表耳机附加声学模态在隐蔽 HCI 场景的前沿探索
papers.summary_en: ReHEarSSE recognizes silently spelled letter sequences using in-ear acoustic sensing: the user covertly articulates letters using tongue and mouth movements without producing audible sound, and the in-ear microphone captures the resulting changes in oral cavity acoustic resonance to decode the spelled content. The system targets discrete, hidden communication scenarios where audible speech is socially unacceptable, positioning earphones as a covert text-entry interface. Validation across multiple participants demonstrates character-level recognition of common expressions with accuracy competitive with surface EMG-based silent speech interfaces. The approach leverages only the microphone already present in off-the-shelf earphones, requiring no additional sensing hardware.
papers.summary_zh: ReHEarSSE 利用入耳声学传感识别隐秘无声拼写序列：用户通过舌头和嘴部动作无声拼写字母，入耳麦克风捕获口腔共鸣腔变化以解码拼写内容。系统针对声音输入在社交场合不适当的隐秘通信场景，将耳机定位为隐蔽文字输入界面。多名受试者验证展示了字符级识别常用表达的准确率，与表面 EMG 无声语音接口相比具有竞争力。该方案仅依赖现成耳机内置的麦克风，无需额外传感硬件。

papers.title: EyeEcho: Continuous and Low-power Facial Expression Tracking on Glasses
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 将 EarIO 耳机声呐范式移植到眼镜框实现连续表情跟踪（CHI 2024，33 次引用）：眼镜框上的压电换能器发射声波探测脸颊/下颌组织，可识别 21 个面部动作单元（AU），3.6mW 极低功耗支持全天穿戴；Ke Li 组将声学传感从耳机跨越到眼镜的关键跳板论文
papers.summary_en: EyeEcho mounts a piezoelectric transmitter and receiver pair on a glasses frame to emit and capture ultrasonic echoes that probe the facial skin around the cheek and jaw. By analyzing echo waveform changes, EyeEcho tracks 21 facial action units (AUs) continuously with an average AU intensity error below 0.3 on the 5-point FACs scale. The system operates at 3.6mW, enabling all-day sensing without battery anxiety. Tested across 30 participants, it achieves expression recognition accuracy comparable to camera-based baselines without requiring any visual sensor. EyeEcho is the direct translation of EarIO earphone-sonar concept to eyewear, bridging the earable and smart-glasses acoustic sensing research streams.
papers.summary_zh: EyeEcho 在眼镜框上安装压电收发对，发射超声波并捕获脸颊和下颌皮肤的回波，通过分析回波波形变化连续追踪 21 个面部动作单元（AU），平均 AU 强度误差低于 0.3（5 点 FACs 量表）。系统功耗 3.6mW，支持全天使用。在 30 名受试者上测试，表情识别准确率与摄像头基线相当，且无需任何视觉传感器。EyeEcho 是将 EarIO 耳机声呐概念直接迁移到眼镜的关键成果，桥接了耳戴和智能眼镜声学传感两条研究线。

papers.title: GazeTrak: Exploring Acoustic-based Eye Tracking on a Glass Frame
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首次在眼镜框实现基于声学的眼动追踪（MobiCom 2024，30 次引用）：利用眼镜框超声声呐探测眼球表面反射推算注视方向，<5° 误差 / 30Hz / <10mW，实现无摄像头的隐私保护型眼动追踪；MobiCom 顶会发表，是智能眼镜无摄像头感知方向的标志性工作
papers.summary_en: GazeTrak uses ultrasonic sonar on smart glass frames to track eye gaze without cameras: acoustic signals emitted from one temple reflect off the eyeball surface and return to a receiver on the opposite temple, encoding gaze direction in the time-of-flight and amplitude patterns. The system achieves 2D gaze estimation with under 5° angular error at 30Hz sample rate while consuming less than 10mW. User evaluation across diverse eye shapes and wearing positions demonstrates robustness to earphone placement variation. GazeTrak demonstrates that camera-free eye tracking at privacy-sensitive accuracy levels is achievable with miniature acoustic hardware, directly complementing EchoSpeech mouth-sensing and EyeEcho facial AU tracking on the same hardware platform.
papers.summary_zh: GazeTrak 利用智能眼镜框上的超声声呐实现无摄像头眼动追踪：从一侧镜腿发射声学信号，信号从眼球表面反射后由另一侧接收器捕获，通过飞行时间和幅度模式推算注视方向。系统 2D 注视估计精度低于 5° 角误差，采样率 30Hz，功耗低于 10mW。在多种眼型和佩戴位置上验证了对耳机放置变化的鲁棒性。GazeTrak 表明在隐私敏感精度水平上实现无摄像头眼动追踪是可行的，与 EchoSpeech（口部感知）和 EyeEcho（面部 AU 追踪）在同一硬件平台上形成互补。

papers.title: ID.EARS: One-Ear EEG Device with Biosignal Noise for Real-Time Gesture Recognition and Various Interactions
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 在单耳耳机中集成 EEG 电极实现实时手势识别与用户认证（CHI 2025）：单耳 EEG 信号叠加生物信号噪声特征，既可识别手势命令又可同步验证用户身份；将 EEG 感知压缩到极小型单耳形态，代表耳机 BCI 当前前沿
papers.summary_en: ID.EARS integrates EEG sensing electrodes into a single-ear earphone form factor, enabling simultaneous gesture recognition and user identification from a single dry contact point at the ear. The system leverages biosignal noise embedded in the EEG signal as a user-specific biometric fingerprint, so the gesture classifier and identity verifier share the same raw signal pipeline without additional sensors. Real-time inference runs on the earphone itself, achieving gesture recognition across common interaction commands with latency under 200ms. The one-ear constraint deliberately targets wearability: a wearer can use a regular earphone in the other ear while ID.EARS captures neural signals unobtrusively.
papers.summary_zh: ID.EARS 在单耳耳机形态中集成 EEG 感知电极，通过耳部单一干电极接触点同步实现手势识别和用户身份验证。系统利用 EEG 信号中嵌入的生物信号噪声作为用户特异性生物特征指纹，手势分类器与身份验证器共享同一原始信号流，无需额外传感器。实时推理在耳机端运行，常用交互命令的手势识别延迟低于 200ms。单耳约束刻意追求可穿戴性：用户可在另一只耳朵佩戴普通耳机，同时 ID.EARS 在另一侧无感采集神经信号。

papers.title: OpenEarable 2.0: Open-Source Earphone Platform for Physiological Ear Sensing
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 迄今功能最全面的开源耳机传感平台（IMWUT 2025，26 次引用）：集成 IMU、气压计、PPG、皮肤温度、UV、麦克风、RGB 光谱仪共 8 种传感器，WiFi 实时数据流，是本领域研究者事实上的开源硬件参考平台
papers.summary_en: OpenEarable 2.0 is an open-source research earphone platform integrating eight sensor modalities: 6-axis IMU, barometric pressure, photoplethysmography (PPG), skin temperature, UV index, microphone, and an RGB spectrophotometer, all in a single in-ear form factor with WiFi connectivity for real-time streaming. The platform comes with an open SDK, documentation for custom firmware development, and reference applications for vital sign monitoring (heart rate from PPG), activity recognition (IMU), and acoustic sensing. With 26 citations by mid-2025, it is the most widely adopted open earable platform and serves as the hardware base for numerous concurrent sensing studies across the field. The companion paper OpenEarable ExG extends this platform with biopotential electrodes.
papers.summary_zh: OpenEarable 2.0 是开源研究耳机平台，在单一入耳形态中集成 8 种传感模态：6 轴 IMU、气压计、PPG 光电容积脉搏波、皮肤温度、UV 指数、麦克风和 RGB 光谱仪，支持 WiFi 实时数据流。平台提供开源 SDK、自定义固件开发文档，以及生命体征监测（PPG 心率）、活动识别（IMU）和声学传感的参考应用。截至 2025 年中获 26 次引用，是领域内采用最广泛的开源耳戴平台。同组 OpenEarable ExG 伴随论文在此平台基础上进一步添加生物电位电极。

papers.title: ElectraSight: Fully Onboard Eye Tracking for Smart Glasses With Hybrid EOG (hEOG)
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 在智能眼镜上实现完全车载（onboard）EOG 眼动追踪（IEEE IoT Journal 2025）：混合 EOG（hEOG）结合传统电极与 PPG 补偿运动伪迹，<1° 精度且所有推理在眼镜端运行；与声学眼动追踪（GazeTrak）形成互补的生理信号方案，代表眼镜附加模态的最新前沿
papers.summary_en: ElectraSight achieves fully onboard eye tracking on smart glasses using hybrid EOG (hEOG), which combines traditional electrooculography electrodes around the frame with photoplethysmography signals to compensate for motion-induced artifacts, a key limitation of pure EOG in mobile settings. All signal processing and gaze inference run on the glasses embedded processor without cloud offloading, achieving under 1 degree accuracy. The hybrid electrode placement on the glasses frame avoids the need for facial adhesive electrodes used in clinical EOG setups. ElectraSight represents the physiological-signal alternative to acoustic eye tracking (GazeTrak), offering sub-degree accuracy at the cost of requiring electrode contact with skin around the frame.
papers.summary_zh: ElectraSight 在智能眼镜上使用混合 EOG（hEOG）实现完全车载眼动追踪：将眼镜框架上的传统电位差测量电极与 PPG 信号结合，以补偿运动引起的伪迹（纯 EOG 在移动场景的关键局限）。所有信号处理和注视推理在眼镜嵌入式处理器本地运行，无需云端，精度低于 1°。眼镜框架上的混合电极布置避免了临床 EOG 需要的皮肤粘贴电极。ElectraSight 是声学眼动追踪（GazeTrak）的生理信号替代方案，以需要电极与皮肤接触为代价换取亚度级精度。

papers.title: VueBuds: Visual Intelligence with Wireless Earbuds
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 首个在无线耳机中集成微型摄像头实现视觉智能的 CHI 2026 工作：从耳朵位置捕获侧向第一人称视频，在设备端运行视觉模型提供场景理解，赋予耳机看的能力；代表耳机视觉模态的最新前沿探索
papers.summary_en: VueBuds integrates a miniature side-facing camera into wireless earbuds to give earphones visual intelligence capabilities: the camera captures egocentric video from the ear position, and an on-device vision model processes scene context to enable visual question answering, object identification, and activity recognition from the ear viewpoint. The system addresses the fundamental audio-only limitation of current earphones by adding vision as a complementary sensing modality without requiring a separate glasses or wrist device. The ear position provides a unique lateral viewpoint that complements standard front-facing phone cameras. CHI 2026 presentation establishes earphone-integrated cameras as an emerging research direction.
papers.summary_zh: VueBuds 将微型侧向摄像头集成到无线耳机中，赋予耳机视觉智能能力：摄像头从耳部位置捕获第一人称视频，设备端视觉模型处理场景上下文，实现视觉问答、物体识别和从耳部视角进行活动识别。系统通过将视觉作为互补传感模态加入耳机，解决了当前耳机仅限音频的根本局限，无需额外眼镜或手腕设备。耳部位置提供了独特的侧向视角，与标准前置手机摄像头互补。CHI 2026 发表，将耳机集成摄像头确立为新兴研究方向。

papers.title: EarSleeve: Transforming Everyday Earphones into a 12-Lead ECG Sensing Platform
papers.timeline_reason_zh: 最新（SenSys 2026）将普通耳机改造为临床级 12 导联 ECG 平台：套管附件在耳道周围添加 ECG 电极，利用耳道近动脉环境采集媲美标准胸部电极的心电信号；将 ECG 这一新模态引入耳机，代表耳机心脏监测的最前沿
papers.summary_en: EarSleeve adds a sleeve accessory to standard earphones that positions ECG electrodes in and around the ear canal, transforming commodity earphones into a 12-lead ECG sensing platform. The ear canal proximity to the external carotid artery and its naturally conductive environment enable high-quality cardiac electrical signals. The system produces 12-lead ECG recordings clinically comparable to standard chest-electrode setups, demonstrated on arrhythmia detection, stress monitoring, and HRV analysis tasks. By avoiding any chest-worn electrodes, EarSleeve enables cardiac monitoring in natural everyday settings using an unmodified earphone as the only body contact point beyond the sleeve. SenSys 2026.
papers.summary_zh: EarSleeve 为标准耳机添加套管附件，在耳道内外布置 ECG 电极，将普通耳机改造为 12 导联 ECG 感知平台。耳道与颈外动脉相邻，加上耳道天然导电环境，可采集高质量心脏电信号。系统产生的 12 导联 ECG 记录在心律失常检测、压力监测和 HRV 分析任务中与标准胸部电极临床相当。通过避免任何胸部电极，EarSleeve 仅以套管作为唯一额外接触在日常自然场景实现心脏监测。SenSys 2026 发表。

papers.title: Lessons Learned from Developing a Privacy-Preserving Multimodal Wearable for Local Voice-and-Vision Inference
papers.timeline_reason_zh: arXiv 补充：记录开发隐私保护多模态穿戴设备（声音+视觉）的工程经验，所有 AI 推理在设备端本地运行；与 VueBuds 共同代表耳戴/头戴多模态感知的隐私优先设计思路
papers.summary_en: This experience report documents the engineering lessons from building a privacy-preserving head-worn wearable that combines microphone and camera inputs for voice-and-vision AI inference, with all computation running locally on-device to avoid cloud transmission of sensitive audio-visual data. Key challenges covered include power budget management for simultaneous audio and vision inference, efficient multi-modal fusion at the edge, and privacy threat modeling for always-on wearable sensing systems. The paper provides practical guidance on battery life, thermal management, and latency tradeoffs when deploying multimodal AI on resource-constrained wearable hardware, complementing the hardware platform contributions of OpenEarable 2.0 and VueBuds.
papers.summary_zh: 本经验报告记录了开发隐私保护头戴式穿戴设备的工程教训，该设备结合麦克风和摄像头进行语音和视觉 AI 推理，所有计算在设备端本地运行以避免敏感视听数据上传云端。涵盖的关键挑战包括音视频同时推理的功率预算管理、边缘端高效多模态融合，以及常态化穿戴传感系统的隐私威胁建模。论文提供了在资源受限穿戴硬件上部署多模态 AI 时电池寿命、热管理和延迟权衡的实践指导，与 OpenEarable 2.0 和 VueBuds 的硬件平台贡献互补。
